name: Fenspiride

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2019 — for heart harm

summary: Fenspiride was taken off the market in the European Union starting in 2019 due to heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on human beings, rated its potential risk to the heart as high [M]. The same computer model showed a low risk for harm to the liver [M].
